column1: # 简体中文 (zh-hans) interface catalog for NetLabCraft.
# Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> English source text <TAB> translation
#   context  usually empty. `@plural`, `@id` and `@msg` mean something to the app; any other
#            word is a label that tells apart two meanings of the same English (`event` marks
#            the phrases replaced inside the simulator's event summaries).
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{}` placeholders (messages with parts) must appear
#            the same number of times in both columns, in the order the language wants, and a
#            trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   @plural  English `one|other`; the translation lists this language's plural forms, `|`-separated.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No other product's localisation, string table or translated UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way.

column2: FW1 has three named interfaces: inside (level 100), dmz (50) and outside (0). The office and the DMZ reach the Internet through the outside address (`show xlate`, `show conn`); Home can't start anything towards them, except the web server, published as 203.0.113.10 by a static rule and one access rule (`show access-list` counts the hits). From Home, browse http://203.0.113.10 and ping PC1 to see the difference; `show logging` on FW1 tells why a packet was dropped. The global policy inspects ICMP, so pings from the office come back without a rule; FW1 is not a hop, so a traceroute from PC1 starts at the ISP router; and FW1 ignores pings to its outside address (`icmp deny any outside`).
column3: FW1 有三个命名接口：inside（级别 100）、dmz（50）和 outside（0）。办公室和 DMZ 通过 outside 地址访问 Internet (`show xlate`, `show conn`)；Home 不能向它们发起任何连接，只有 Web 服务器例外，它由一条静态规则发布为 203.0.113.10，并有一条访问规则（`show access-list` 统计命中次数）。在 Home 上浏览 http://203.0.113.10 并 ping PC1，可看出区别；FW1 上的 `show logging` 会说明数据包为何被丢弃。全局策略会检查 ICMP，所以办公室发出的 ping 无需规则即可返回；FW1 不是一跳，因此 PC1 的 traceroute 从 ISP 路由器开始；FW1 会忽略对其 outside 地址的 ping (`icmp deny any outside`)。
